card.name: Argentine Tango
card.tagline: Close-embrace improvised partner dance of Río de la Plata passion.
card.profile: Argentine tango is a partner dance and musical genre that developed in the working-class immigrant neighborhoods (arrabales) and academias of Buenos Aires and Montevideo in the late 19th century, evolving from milonga, candombe, and habanera. It is danced in a close or open embrace built on improvised walking, with the bandoneón giving the orquesta típica its distinctive voice (English Wikipedia). Lyrics are marked by nostalgia and lost love; leading figures include Carlos Gardel and Ástor Piazzolla.
card.insight: Tango was recognized by Argentina's Ley 24.684 (1996) as integral to the nation's cultural patrimony, covering its music, lyrics, and dance; it embodies and encourages cultural dialogue across the Río de la Plata (Argentina InfoLeg; UNESCO).
